## Plan / implementation

- `crates/hh-hir/src/debt.rs` — `validate_removal_test_at(record,
  Option<&DebtHome>, ctx)`: the home-free entry point for callers that
  cannot name the `DebtHome` (the manager sweep — `SweepEntry.home` is
  caller-projected). Identical checks; only the refusal *detail* text
  degrades when `home` is `None` — never the verdict (D1).
- `crates/hh-ontology/src/eval.rs` — `PreRegistration.dead_weight_purpose`
  (additive, default `false`, emitted only when true — `/1` bodies
  untouched); `is_pinned_version_id` now `pub` — the one §5h.2 §2 pin
  spelling reused for the `artifact_sealed` leg (CC1).
- `crates/hh-debt/src/schedule.rs` — `instantiate_check` runs the
  context battery under the resolvers the schedule point honestly
  binds: `policy`/`declared_sinks` from the operative `DebtPolicy`,
  `resolve_template`/`split_assigned`/`artifact_sealed` from the
  caller-resolved template. `probe_ref_known`/`zero_use_scope_resolved`
  stay absent (those kinds defer `static_kind` upstream);
  `diff_removed_rules` is settle/propose-side. Context misses are
  `Deferred{reason}` — new spellings `unexecutable:<reason>`,
  `insufficient_runway`, `owner_unreachable`,
  `dead_weight_design_disallowed`; `schedule_batch` refuses a failing
  member `BatchIncompatible`. `PRIORITY_SPELLINGS` (closed set
  `["expiry_urgency"]`) checked at schedule + batch.
- `crates/hh-debt/src/records.rs` — `SchedulableEntry.home`
  (caller-projected `DebtHomes/1` id → the home row for the context
  checks); `DebtManagerRecord::validate` refuses an empty
  `policy.schedule` and an out-of-set `policy.priority` at register
  (AC-R-2.9.6-12 — fail fast, never at the sweep).
- `crates/hh-debt/src/manager.rs` — the sweep projects `entry.home`
  into `SchedulableEntry`; `sweep.completed` carries `kind: cadence` +
  `cadence` = the operative `policy.schedule` spelling (the `schedule`
  member is load-bearing on the durable row).
- `crates/hh-lab/src/debt.rs` — `ProfileChange.changed_at_ms`
  (additive): `evaluate_debt` derives the `retired`-grace hard leg as
  `changed_at_ms + policy.grace_period_ms <= now_ms`, OR-ed with the
  caller's `grace_elapsed` flag — a policy fact, not a caller claim
  (D3).
- `crates/hh-embed/src/debt_ops.rs` — `observables` decodes the
  additive `changed_at_ms`; `evaluate_debt_on_lifecycle` stamps it at
  the transaction time.
- `crates/hh-embed/src/debt_manager_ops.rs` — `resolve_template` +
  `resolve_entry_templates`: `lab.debt.sweep` fills
  `entries[].template` through `LabDocs` (`docs.spec` then
  `get_named(SPEC)`) when the caller does not project it; a store miss
  keeps `template_unresolved`; a corrupt deposit is a schema violation
  (D4).
- Fixture updates: `PreRegistration` constructors across the workspace
  gain `dead_weight_purpose: false` (additive member); `hh-debt`/`
  hh-embed` manager fixtures declare `notice_sinks: ["sink:ops"]` — the
  sink their fixture records' `owner.reach_via` names (the schedule
  point now binds the declared sink table — an empty table with a
  declared `reach_via` is correctly `owner_unreachable`).
- Batteries: `hh-debt/tests/r2_17.rs` (10 — every context leg +
  policy spellings + the `cadence` durable row),
  `hh-embed/tests/r2_17.rs` (3 — the LabDocs-resolved schedule leg,
  the unresolved spelling, records-in authoritative),
  `hh-lab/tests/r2_17.rs` (3 — the grace legs),
  `hh-bench/tests/r2_17.rs` (6 — `task_id` round-trip/check_id/
  annotation-invariance, suite record round-trips + L1/L2 admission,
  adapter `expose` preservation).
- `docs/adr/ADR-0349` — the five owned rulings.
